text: The Philippine Health Insurance Corporation, widely known as "PhilHealth," is a government-organized health insurance program that ensures free healthcare for all Filipino citizens. Funded partly by government subsidies at both the local and national levels, as well as through company payroll deductions, PhilHealth embodies the Philippines' commitment to universal health coverage. The program is structured into two categories: those who can afford to pay premiums and those who cannot, such as the unemployed and elderly. For individuals unable to pay, the government steps in to sponsor their insurance coverage, thereby maintaining equitable access to healthcare services for all.
